contract: Only a checked 8-bit USB read at 0x00fc establishes the initial proof; every code other than 0x0a/0x13 and every read error fails without writes.
The HALMAC SDIO leave-suspend write/poll flow is deliberately excluded.
The runtime profile changes only family and preserves actual VID/PID, name, constraints and primary_verified=0. Immutable catalog metadata APIs continue rejecting copied profiles.
Proof binds its own caller storage, original immutable row, complete bus/cookie, current descriptor, provider and one Boot context.
Revalidate before bootstrap cleanup, identify, power-on, firmware request/download, final publication and power-off; failed proof forbids subsequent transport writes.
Station eligibility remains 262 statically verified profiles. One separate guarded discovery personality does not increase static verification.
No 0bda:8192 resolution or other ambiguous identity fallback is implemented.
Tests model USB and firmware execution; software validation does not constitute physical-device certification.
